$comment: Atlas rulebase v0 — obligation rules over ProcessIR event types (specs/kernel/SPEC.md §3; blueprint §6.3: rules fire only on IR-confirmed events, never surface keywords). Status field is the provenance contract: 'transcribed' = sourced from paper/blueprint/adjudicated fixtures; 'drafted' = agent-drafted with owner approval (2026-06-12 session). PROTECTED PATH.

rules.provenance: blueprint §3.1 example rule 'opens_obligation(Event, authority_obligation) :- event_type(Event, privileged_transition), not authority_evidence(Event)'; mandatory/blocking per fixtures/kernel/kernel-002 obligation facts; safeDefault per fixtures/trap_set/trap-001 (violated authority ⇒ deny)

blueprint §6.3 'a state_destruction event in the causal graph opens an evidence obligation'; fixtures/trap_set/trap-002 adjudication; safeDefault per trap-002 (unfetchable evidence ⇒ pending, gap budget_exhausted)

drafted (owner-approved 2026-06-12). Rationale: a commitment made to an external party creates two states that must agree — what was promised and what internally holds (paper §3.6.3: divergent states that should agree resolve via Reconciliation). Until the external and internal records reconcile, closure is unlicensed; unresolvable ⇒ pending (INV-7).

drafted (owner-approved 2026-06-12). Rationale: leaving a Boundary scope is the moment parent-scope Invariants must hold again (paper §8.3: Authority edges carry inherited invariants; a child cannot override them). Exit without revalidation is how locally-valid work breaks global constraints; unverifiable ⇒ pending.

drafted (owner-approved 2026-06-12). Rationale: an effect that cannot be undone demands the supporting evidence exist BEFORE the act, by analogy with the sourced state_destruction rule (blueprint §6.3) — irreversibility is the property that makes missing evidence unrecoverable.

drafted (owner-approved 2026-06-12). Rationale: evidence supporting an irreversible act must be valid AT execution time, not merely have existed (trap-001's adjudication: approval expired before execution — stale authority is the trap). EvidenceRef.validUntil (decay-as-TTL) is the mechanism; expired-or-unknown freshness ⇒ pending.
